plugins.name: dominodatalab
plugins.description: Full Domino Data Lab platform support — workspaces, jobs, model deployment, experiment tracking, GenAI tracing, Spark/Ray/Dask, and app deployment for data science teams

skills.name: domino-ai-gateway
skills.description: Access external LLM providers through Domino AI Gateway - a secure proxy with centralized API key management, usage monitoring, and compliance. Supports OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, and more. Use when calling LLMs from Domino, configuring AI Gateway endpoints, or monitoring LLM usage and costs.
headings: Configure client to use AI Gateway
skills.description_zh: 通过Domino AI Gateway安全代理调用外部大模型，集中管理密钥、用量和合规，支持OpenAI、Bedrock、Azure与Anthropic及成本监测。

skills.name: domino-apps
skills.description: Deploy web applications to Domino Data Lab with expertise in React apps (Vite) behind Domino's reverse proxy. Covers app.sh configuration, port configuration, base path handling for SPAs, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, and proxy troubleshooting. Use when deploying apps to Domino, setting up CI/CD pipelines, fixing broken routing, or configuring JavaScript frameworks for Domino's proxy.
headings: Get bearer [已隐藏] for inter-app communication
1. Get access token from Domino's token service
skills.description_zh: 将网页应用部署到Domino Data Lab，配置React与Vite、app.sh、端口、单页应用基础路径、GitHub Actions及反向代理路由。

skills.name: domino-data-connectivity
skills.description: Connect Domino workloads to external data sources including AWS S3 (via Mountpoint CSI driver), credential propagation with AWS IRSA and Azure Entra ID, and External Data Volumes. Use when configuring S3 access, setting up credential propagation, or connecting to cloud data sources from Domino.
headings: S3 data appears as local files
No explicit credentials needed - IRSA provides them
skills.description_zh: 连接Domino工作负载与S3等云数据源，配置Mountpoint CSI、AWS IRSA和Azure Entra身份凭据传递及外部数据卷。

skills.name: domino-datasets
skills.description: Work with Domino Datasets - high-performance, versioned filesystem storage. Covers dataset creation, snapshots for versioning, sharing across projects, mounting paths (/domino/datasets/), and performance optimization. Use when managing data storage, creating reproducible data versions, or sharing data between projects.
headings: How to Identify Your Project Type
skills.description_zh: 管理Domino高性能版本化数据集文件存储，创建快照、跨项目共享、挂载路径并优化性能，支持可复现数据版本。

skills.name: domino-distributed-computing
skills.description: Work with distributed computing frameworks in Domino including Apache Spark, Ray, and Dask clusters. Covers cluster configuration, on-demand clusters, choosing between frameworks, PySpark usage, and scaling workloads. Use when processing large datasets, parallel ML training, or running distributed compute jobs.
skills.description_zh: 在Domino配置和扩展Spark、Ray或Dask分布式计算，选择框架、按需集群、PySpark、大数据处理与并行模型训练。

skills.name: domino-data-sdk
skills.description: Use the domino-data Python SDK (dominodatalab-data) for programmatic data access in Domino. Covers DataSourceClient for SQL queries and object storage, DatasetClient for dataset files, TrainingSets for ML data versioning, Feature Store, and VectorDB (Pinecone) integration. Use when querying data sources, downloading datasets, managing training sets, or working with vector databases in Domino.
headings: Get a data source by name
skills.description_zh: 使用domino-data Python SDK查询SQL与对象存储、下载数据集文件、管理训练数据版本和特征库，并集成Pinecone向量数据库。

skills.name: domino-governance
skills.description: Manage model risk governance in Domino using policies, bundles, and evidence. Covers creating governance bundles, attaching model artifacts and MLflow results as evidence, progressing through policy stages, and documenting findings. Use when the user mentions governance, compliance, bundles, policies, model risk management, SR 11-7, NIST AI RMF, or audit trails.
headings: Governance is NOT routed through $DOMINO_API_HOST (internal Kubernetes).
Derive the external cluster URL from the JWT iss claim — works in any workspace type.
skills.description_zh: 通过Domino政策、治理包和证据管理模型风险，附加模型及MLflow产物、推进政策阶段并记录发现，支持合规和审计轨迹。

skills.name: domino-ui-bootstrap
skills.description: Bootstrap or retrofit a Vite + React 18 + TypeScript project so it uses the Domino design system (`@dominodatalab/extensions-tools`). Scoped to projects that are (or will be) a **fully standalone SPA frontend for a Domino application or extension** — not snippets, library additions, or work inside an existing Domino monorepo package. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, build, scaffold, start, refactor, retrofit, or set up such an SPA — a React app, web app, frontend, UI, or extension that should "look like Domino", use Domino components, follow the Domino design system, or integrate with the Domino platform — even when they don't say the word "Domino" explicitly but mention Domino-flavored terms like DominoThemeProviderDecorator, extensions-tools, or base-components. Also use when the user points at an existing standalone React/Vite project and asks to make it "Domino-styled", wire it up to the Domino component library, add Domino theming, or migrate it. The skill handles version pinning (React 18, react-router 5), MCP registration for the Storybook component reference, theme provider wiring, and a verification step — all things that are easy to get wrong otherwise.
headings: Step 3 — Scaffold (only if empty / nonexistent / overwrite chosen)
Step 4 — Align `package.json` to the Domino invariants
Step 7 — Wire up the React entry point
Step 8 — Make URLs proxy-aware (assets AND API calls)
8a. `base: './'` in `vite.config.ts` (the scaffold does NOT set this)
Step 9 — Starter screen (only for fresh scaffolds)
Components safe to use without an MCP query
Watch out: `node_modules` README uses the Storybook alias
skills.description_zh: 为Domino应用或扩展的独立Vite、React 18与TypeScript前端建立或改造设计系统，固定版本、接入组件Storybook MCP与主题并验证；不用于片段或既有单仓包。

skills.name: domino-ui-design
skills.description: Build Domino-styled web applications matching the Domino Design System. Use when creating or styling Domino apps (Dash, Streamlit, Flask, FastAPI+HTML), generating UI components, reviewing UX, or when the user mentions "Domino app", "Domino UI", "Domino dashboard", or "Domino design system". Covers the full stack — FastAPI backend, Ant Design 5.x frontend via CDN, Domino theme tokens (colors, typography, spacing), chart styling with Highcharts, Domino API authentication, proxy-safe routing, UX writing, error handling, empty states, form design, table patterns, and layout best practices. Also use for UX reviews of existing Domino app screenshots.
headings: Governance is not routed through $DOMINO_API_HOST. Derive the external cluster URL
from the JWT iss claim — works in any workspace type.
skills.description_zh: 构建或审查符合Domino设计系统的应用，覆盖FastAPI、Ant Design、主题、图表、API认证、代理路由、文案、表单、表格及错误空状态。

skills.name: domino-environments
skills.description: Create and customize Domino Compute Environments - Docker containers defining tools, packages, and configurations. Covers Dockerfile customization, package installation, IDE configuration, DSE (Domino Standard Environments), and troubleshooting build failures. Use when installing dependencies, customizing environments, or fixing environment issues.
skills.description_zh: 创建与定制Domino计算环境容器，配置Dockerfile、依赖、IDE和标准环境，排查构建与运行环境问题。

skills.name: domino-experiment-tracking
skills.description: Track traditional ML experiments in Domino using the MLflow-based Experiment Manager. Covers experiment setup, auto-logging for sklearn/TensorFlow/PyTorch, manual logging, artifact storage, run comparison, and model registration. Use when training ML models, logging metrics and parameters, comparing model runs, or registering models.
headings: CRITICAL: Experiment names must be unique across Domino deployment
skills.description_zh: 通过基于MLflow的Domino Experiment Manager追踪传统机器学习实验，配置自动或手工日志、产物、运行比较与模型注册。

skills.name: domino-flows
skills.description: Orchestrate multi-step ML workflows using Domino Flows (built on Flyte). Define DAGs with typed inputs/outputs, heterogeneous environments, automatic lineage, and reproducibility. Use when building data pipelines, multi-stage training workflows, or processes requiring orchestration and monitoring.
headings: Always commit and push first — jobs run against remote repo state
skills.description_zh: 通过基于Flyte的Domino Flows协调多步机器学习，建立类型化输入输出DAG、异构环境、自动血缘与可复现流程，用于管道和多阶段训练监控。

skills.name: domino-genai-tracing
skills.description: Trace and evaluate GenAI applications including LLM calls, agents, RAG pipelines, and multi-step AI systems in Domino. Uses the Domino SDK (@add_tracing decorator, DominoRun context) with MLflow 3.2.0. Captures token usage, latency, cost, tool calls, and errors. Supports LLM-as-judge evaluators and custom metrics. Use when building agents, debugging LLM applications, or needing audit trails for GenAI systems.
headings: main.py — lifespan: autolog only, NO set_experiment, NO DominoRun
orchestrator.py — @add_tracing on the core agent function
router.py — call the traced function directly, NO DominoRun wrapper
DominoRun groups traces into a run visible in Experiments
skills.description_zh: 通过Domino SDK与MLflow 3.2追踪和评估LLM、智能体与RAG，记录令牌、延迟、成本、工具和错误，支持模型裁判、自定义指标及审计。

skills.name: domino-jobs
skills.description: Create, run, and manage Domino Jobs - batch executions for scripts, training, and data processing. Covers job configuration, hardware tiers, scheduled jobs (cron), monitoring status, viewing logs, and API-driven execution. Use when running batch workloads, scheduling recurring tasks, or automating training pipelines.
skills.description_zh: 创建、运行和管理Domino批量作业，配置硬件、计划、状态、日志与API执行，用于脚本、训练和数据处理。

skills.name: domino-launchers
skills.description: Create Domino Launchers - parameterized web forms for self-service job execution. Enable business users to run analyses, generate reports, and trigger batch predictions without coding. Covers parameter types, email notifications, result delivery, and access control. Use when building self-service data products or enabling non-technical users.
headings: Save results (will be available to launcher user)
skills.description_zh: 创建参数化Domino Launcher网页表单，让业务用户无代码执行分析、报告和批量预测，配置参数、通知、结果与访问控制。

skills.name: domino-model-endpoints
skills.description: Deploy and monitor model API endpoints in Domino. Covers creating prediction endpoints, version management, Grafana dashboards for latency/errors/resources, alerting, and GPU inference with NVIDIA Triton. Use when deploying models as APIs, monitoring production endpoints, or debugging endpoint issues.
headings: Add to your environment's Dockerfile instructions
skills.description_zh: 部署和监控Domino模型API端点，管理版本、Grafana延迟错误资源看板、告警及NVIDIA Triton GPU推理。

skills.name: domino-model-monitoring

Covers data drift analysis, prediction capture, baseline comparison, alert configuration, and remediation workflows. Use when monitoring production models, detecting drift, or setting up model health alerts.

skills.description_zh: 监测Domino部署模型的数据漂移和质量，采集预测、比较基准、设置健康告警与处置流程。

skills.name: domino-modeling-assistant
skills.description: Enable AI-assisted model development within Domino by writing needed model and training code and using MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to execute domino jobs. Use when setting up AI code assistants to work with Domino, configuring MCP servers, or enabling vibe modeling workflows.

skills.name: netapp-volumes
skills.description: Work with Domino Volumes for NetApp ONTAP - enterprise-grade, multi-terabyte storage with near-instant snapshots. Covers volume creation, snapshot versioning with commit messages, cross-project sharing, mount paths (/mnt/netapp-volumes/ or /domino/netapp-volumes/), and the NetApp Volumes REST API. Use when managing large-scale data storage, needing fast no-copy snapshots, or integrating existing NetApp ONTAP infrastructure with Domino.

Auth token from in-cluster token service

skills.description_zh: 管理Domino NetApp ONTAP多TB数据卷，创建带提交信息的快速快照、跨项目共享、挂载和REST API访问，支持无复制版本与既有存储集成。

skills.name: domino-python-sdk
skills.description: Programmatically interact with Domino using python-domino SDK and REST APIs. Covers authentication, running jobs, managing projects, file operations, model deployment, and automation. Use when automating Domino workflows, integrating with CI/CD, or building custom tooling around Domino.

skills.description_zh: 使用python-domino SDK和REST API认证、运行作业、管理项目文件与模型部署，用于工作流、CI/CD和自定义工具自动化。

skills.name: tags-and-properties
skills.description: Manage Domino tags and properties via the Taxonomy API. Covers tags/namespaces (create, list, update, delete; tag entities — project, model, dataset, app, project_template, netapp_volume; query by tag; autocomplete; merge; CSV import/export) AND properties (typed metadata fields — text, number, date, boolean, url, user, organization, select, multi_select — with per-entity values, groups, and versioned entities like model_version/app_version). Use when organizing entities with tags, building hierarchical namespaces, defining typed metadata fields, setting property values on projects/models/apps, finding entities by tag, bulk-tagging during onboarding, or migrating taxonomy across environments.
headings: Taxonomy is served through the Domino API host gateway.
1. Discover the tag you want to apply
Workflow 2 — Build a hierarchical taxonomy (governance admin)
Create a child tag under it
Workflow 3 — Find all entities with a tag (discovery)
skills.description_zh: 通过Domino Taxonomy API管理标签命名空间、实体标记、查询合并及CSV迁移，同时配置类型化属性、分组和实体版本值。
